title: Rapid generation of functional and homogeneous excitatory human forebrain neurons using Neurogenin-2 \(Ngn2)
protocol: Plate ~5.0 x 10^6 HEK293T cells in 13 ml of MEF media on T-75 flasks 16-24 hours prior to transfection.
Replace media with 10 ml of fresh MEF media for every T-75 flask of virus produced.
Prepare 10.8 μg of lentiviral plasmid, 8.1 μg of pMDLg/pRRE, 3.25 μg of pRSV-rev, and 4.5 μg of pMD2.G in sterile water for every T-75 flask.
Add 650 μl of 2x BBS to the transfection mixture drop by drop while vortexing and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Lightly mix solution by pipetting up and down and add 1 ml dropwise to each plate of HEK293T cells.
Replace media with 13 ml of fresh MEF media 16-20 hours after transfection.
Check EGFP fluorescence of Tet-O-EGFP plate to ensure that the transfection worked properly.
Harvest viral supernatant 24 hours after transfection.
Filter the harvested supernatant through a 0.45 μm cellulose acetate filter.
Centrifuge the filtered supernatant at 50,000 xg for 1.5 hours at 4°C to concentrate viral particles.
Reconstitute the pellet in 100 μl MEM to obtain a 100x concentrated virus stock.
Store the reconstituted virus stock at -80°C.
Anesthetize postnatal day 0 or 1 pups on ice.
Remove heads from pups and place them in a 6 cm tissue culture dish.
Dissect brains from skulls and put each brain in a 6-cm dish filled with cold HBSS.
Dissect cortices from the brain and separate the two hemispheres.
Remove meninges using fine tweezers and place the hemisphere into a 15 ml falcon tube filled with cold HBSS.
Place the falcon tube on ice.
After collecting all the hemispheres from 2 pups per falcon tube, remove the HBSS.
Add 5 ml dissociation solution to each falcon tube containing brain cortices (5 ml HBSS, 80 μl Papain, 5 μl EDTA (0.5 μM), 5 μl CaCl2 (1 μM)).
Filter the dissociation solution with a 0.22 μm filter and place at 37°C until clear.
Put the tube in the 37°C incubator for 20 minutes.
Shake the tube every 5 minutes.
Remove the dissociation solution carefully.
Wash the tissue twice with MEF media.
Add 1 ml of MEF media and triturate the tissue using a pipette.
Add 12 ml of MEF Media to plate onto T-75 flask.
Change the media on the next day.
Passage the cells in MEF media at least once before using them for experiments.
Passage until P2 and freeze down in freezing medium if necessary.
Plate human ES/iPS cells on Matrigel coated 6-well plate one day before infection.
Dissociate human ES/iPS cells with Accutase and plate 5 x 10^4 - 1 x 10^5 cells/well using mTeSR with Y-compound.
On the day of transduction, remove the mTeSR from the culture.
Add 2 ml of mTeSR containing the lentiviruses (rtTA and Ngn2-puro).
Titer the lentiviruses by adding various amounts to achieve complete infectivity and clean selection.
After 16-18 hours, remove the virus-containing media.
Add N2 media with Doxycycline, BDNF, NT-3, and laminin (N2+B/L/N/Dox).
Change the media with N2+B/L/N/Dox plus puromycin for 24-48 hours.
Plate iN cells together with mouse glial cells on matrigel-coated coverslips.
Dissociate primary mouse glial culture from a T-75 flask using Trypsin/EDTA.
Adjust the number of iN cells to 2-4 x10^5 and dissociate them with Accutase.
Mix iN cells with mouse glial cells in B27 medium supplemented with Doxycycline, BDNF, NT-3, laminin, and 2 μM Ara-C.
Change half of the media on Day 6 using B27+B/L/N/Dox/2Arac.
Repeat media change every 2-3 days until Day 10.
Change half of the media on Day 10 using 2-AraC neuronal growth medium.
Add 0.5 ml of 2-AraC neuronal medium without any change on Day 13 and leave them in the incubator for 7 days.
Remove 250 μl of old media and replace with 350 μl of fresh 2-AraC neuronal growth medium on Day 20.
Change the media every week until maturity.
Plate and infect human ES/iPS cells on Matrigel-coated 24-well plate.
Wash iPS cells with PBS once.
Add 0.5 ml of CTK to remove feeders at 37°C until feeder cells lift off.
Aspirate CTK and wash cells twice with PBS.
Treat iPS cells with Accutase briefly and bring it up with hES media.
Spin down the treated cells at 150g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in a mixture of 50% hES media, 50% mTeSR plus Y-compound, and lentiviruses.
Typically plate 200,000 - 300,000 cells per well with 1 μL of viruses (rtTA and Ngn2-puro) in 1 ml of mixed media.
Remove half of the virus-containing media on Day 0.
Add fresh N2 media containing Doxycycline, BDNF, NT-3, laminin, plus Y-compound.
Change media completely with N2+B/L/N/Dox plus puromycin for 24-48 hours starting from 24 hours after removal of half the virus-containing media.
Wash iN cells once or twice with PBS on Day 3.
Add mouse glial cells in B27 medium containing Doxycycline, BDNF, NT-3, laminin plus 2 Ara-C (2 μM) onto a coverslip.
Change half of the media using B27+B/L/N/Dox/2Arac on Day 5.
Repeat media change every 2-3 days until Day 10.
Change half of the media using 2-AraC neuronal growth medium on Day 10.
Add 0.5 ml of 2-AraC neuronal medium without any further changes on Day 13.
Leave cells in the incubator for 7 days following the addition of 2-AraC neuronal medium.
Remove 250 μL of old media.
Replace with 350 μL of new media (2-AraC neuronal growth medium).
Change the media every week until maturity.
